scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream of the Class 12th board examination (10+2 pattern or equivalent).
Applicant must be pursuing regular degree courses at recognized colleges/institutions approved by AICTE or the respective regulatory bodies.
For each year of renewal, the student must obtain at least 50% marks in the annual examination and maintain a minimum attendance of 75%.
The student must have a bank account opened in their own name.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum for up to three years at the graduation level and ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate and later years of professional courses, disbursed directly via DBT.
